title: NFT3
tagline: Dapp for reforestation efforts from any organization that forks our open source project
description: We are building a public-good infrastructure for reforestation initiatives, using real-life on-chain data and ERC-721 NFTs to represent the trees planted. We also aim to create a validator program in which people can take pictures of these trees as a form of validation that they are being well-maintained, creating the data mentioned before. From this infrastructure, any environmental organization could utilize our open-source platform and fork it for their specific reforestation campaign, issuing NFTs for each tree species and create a proof of donation validation.
how_its_made:
Our platform isn't your typical NFT marketplace. We offer NFTs that represent real, living trees, taking environmental accountability to the next level. But we don't stop there! We've integrated a cutting-edge on-chain validation system to ensure these trees are properly maintained. How? Through a dynamic rewards pool that incentivizes individuals to capture real-life photos during specific payout periods.

CC0 Description:
This open-source platform revolutionizes the idea of NFT ownership by linking it with environmental stewardship. Powered by smart contracts built on IPFS, our system not only facilitates the sale of NFTs that symbolize real trees but also implements an on-chain validation mechanism. This mechanism engages a community of validators who are rewarded for taking real-world photographs of the trees, confirming their well-being and ongoing care.

Smart Contract on IPFS:
Our smart contracts is constructed using the IPFS framework, ensuring decentralized, secure, and transparent operations. This allows us to create a public-good infrastructure that is not only effective but also ethical, paving the way for future innovations in both blockchain and environmental sustainability.
